newsitem.title: FRANCE: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST - AUG 11.
newsitem.headline: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST - AUG 11.

text.p: News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media & the Internet and Brand-name Products.

PARIS - France's billboard firms are using the slogan "Freedom of speech began on walls" for a campaign aimed at portraying themselves as good guys. The campaign was devised by advertising agency Alice, part of Interpublic Group's Lowe Group, for the billboard owners' association, Union de la Publicite Exterieure (UPE). (Reuter)

PARIS - Advertising revenue at M6, France's second biggest private terrestrial television station, rose to 1.08 billion francs ($173.4 million) in the six months to June 30 from 999.1 million in the first half of 1996, the company says in the official Balo bulletin. (Reuter)

PARIS - French broadcasting regulator Conseil Superieur de l'Audiovisuel (CSA) has told Lagardere SCA that its radio stations are over the legal limit for potential audience since Lagardere merged two subsidiaries, a Lagardere spokesman says. (Reuter)

PARIS - Virgin kicks off an advertising campaign for its Virgin Cola in France. The Cola has so far been tested in one French supermarket chain, Monoprix, but will now be sold in four others. (La Tribune)
PARIS - Shares in Pernod Ricard, the French drinks company, rise against the trend after the firm reported a higher than expected 10.4-percent rise in first-half sales. (Reuter)

PARIS - The French record market rose 5.4 percent in volume terms in the first half of 1997, with discs by French artists taking 51.5 percent of the market. Their position was boosted by people buying less than 10 CDs a year, chiefly in hypermarkets, according to a study by market research group IFOP. (La Tribune)
